item.description: ### Fixed - **Claude no longer says "finished" while background work is still running.** When Claude Code ended a turn with a background command or monitor still going, Perch announced it as finished straight away, and again when the work completed. The row now shows "1 background task" (or however many) and the finished alert waits until Claude is actually done. - **An error is not a finish.** When a Claude turn stopped on an error, such as a rate limit, a server error or being signed out, Perch announced it as "finished", and a rate limit got both alerts. The row now names the problem, and a rate limit sends only the rate-limit alert.
